notes: Prism 2.7.0: the new look. One design across Mac and Windows — a cleaner, calmer layout, Prism's new mark, and folders you can create, rename, recolour and nest right from the sidebar. Pick your own avatar in Settings. Tasks gained a full composer: priority, description and a linked note now save on Windows too. The meeting card's wave shows the audio it is actually hearing, and the far end of a call gets the flagship model with speaker labels, so several people on the other end stop being one "Caller". Also fixed: speakerphone calls where everything was labelled Me. Your audio is never stored. Free.
